I Am a Robot!
история Speak & Smile · robot · Turn on! Move! Left! Right! Stop!
тапни / стрелка →
I made a robot!
Tighten the bolts —
my robot friend!
🦝 All done!
Turn on!
Press the button —
beep! Lights on!
🤖 I am a robot!
Move forward!
Step, step, step —
forward we go!
🤖 Beep-boop!
Turn left! Turn right!
This way, that way —
left and right!
🤖 Turning!
STOP!
Freeze! Don't move —
stop, robot, stop!
🤖 …stop.
Dance, robot, dance!
Music on — the robot wiggles —
wibble, wobble! Ha, ha, ha!
🤖 Boogie time!
I love my robot!
Speaky and his robot —
dance, dance, dance!
🦝🤖 Hooray!
